PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Computer Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Concepts.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Concepts.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Concepts.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Concepts.

3. When learning Metallic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metallic Materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Metallic Materials.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metallic Materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metallic Materials.

4. When learning ICT Tools in Communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for ICT Tools in Communication.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ICT Tools in Communication.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ICT Tools in Communication.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ICT Tools in Communication.

5. When learning Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.

6. When learning Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   D. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

8. When learning Free-hand sketching, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Free-hand sketching.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Free-hand sketching.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Free-hand sketching.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Free-hand sketching.

9. When learning Introduction to Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Materials.

10. When learning Non- Metallic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Non- Metallic Materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Non- Metallic Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Non- Metallic Materials.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Non- Metallic Materials.

11. When learning Safety in the Immediate Environment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety in the Immediate Environment.

12. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Production Unit 10 5.3 Financial Goals 10 Total Number of Lessons 120 Note: The  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Goals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
